outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative pseudocoloured photoactivation images without quantification; no replicate reporting is expected.

replicate_statements: Graphs representing normalized intensities measured during relaxation in the circled regions of the experiment displayed in (A) (red: euchromatin, green: heterochromatin).
Insets represent average early time points responses measured in euchromatin and heterochromatin (red and green data sets, respectively) to emphasize on the initial plateau in heterochromatin.
outputs.explanation: Panel B shows quantified intensity curves with averaged data and error bars in the insets, implying replicated measurements, but the legend does not state the number of replicates (cells/experiments) or their type (e.g., biological vs technical replicates).
